the application of 8-hydroxyquinoline sulfate (8-HQS) and savory (Satureja montana L.) extract improved vase life, fresh weight, water uptake, electrolyte leakage, and malondialdehyde (MDA) content of Alstroemerium cut flowers.

the application of natural compounds, such as plant extracts and 8-hydroxyquinoline sulfate, to improve the vase life of cut Alstroemeria flowers.
the use of plant extracts and 8-hydroxyquinoline sulfate to improve the post-harvest quality of Alstroemerian cut flowers.
the use of savory extract as a novel and eco-friendly compound to enhance the postharvest life of Alstroemeri cut flowers.
